samples_reviewed.question_text: Arrange these numbers from largest to smallest: 9, 10, 8
Ana counted marbles collected by 3 friends: 1, 4, 15. Arrange the counts from smallest to largest.
Arrange these numbers from smallest to largest: 5, 3, 1, 10
Ana counted seashells collected by 3 friends: 1, 3, 4. Arrange the counts from largest to smallest.
Arrange these numbers from smallest to largest: 17, 8, 20
Arrange these numbers from smallest to largest: 13, 20, 18
Arrange these numbers from largest to smallest: 20, 11, 17
Arrange these numbers from largest to smallest: 6, 14, 20
Arrange these numbers from largest to smallest: 19, 20, 5
Ben counted storybooks collected by 3 friends: 2, 10, 11. Arrange the counts from smallest to largest.
Arrange these numbers from smallest to largest: 7, 14, 12

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Every sample asks for a full arrangement of a given set, and the response is the ordered list itself rather than a single pick, which is the precise act the competency describes; each key I checked orders its own set correctly.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The and vice versa clause is fully honoured - smallest to largest and largest to smallest each appear in roughly half the fourteen samples - and both three-element and four-element sets are generated, so set size is not held fixed at the easiest value.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Ordering three or four numbers below 21, with narrative items framed as a friend's collection of marbles, seashells or stickers, keeps reading short and the working memory demand appropriate for Quarter 1 of Grade 1.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Bare lists to arrange sit alongside counted collections attributed to named friends, and two distinct ordering response modes are used, so the pupil meets the same skill in both an abstract and a situational dress.

competency_alignment.rationale: Difficulty rises along axes that belong to ordering - from three items to four, and from well-spread sets like 9, 10, 8 to sets mixing a single-digit value with numbers in the high teens - rather than through unrelated context changes.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Every value falls between 1 and 20 with the ceiling itself used repeatedly as a set member, so the stated bound is exercised rather than avoided, and no value strays above it.
